scope: 47 decks / 1057 independent pages; six assigned reviewers and root individual representative/target comparison

knownDifferences.detail: Clash Display actual acquisition returned HTTP403 from official Fontshare; Inter actually loaded approximation retains differences in logo proportions. See font-acquisition.json.
SVG restores visible simple graphic topology, layer counts, outlines and labels. Fine 3D curvature, specular shading and complex photographic texture remain approximations.
Some reference tiles contain incomplete white source crops. Complete 1280x720 layout reconstructed from neighboring slides; lost pixels are not treated as intentional white design.

Tiny unreadable reference wording is replaced by normal prose with matching row count where detectable, rather than line marks. Typography families without determinable original font use closest actually loaded family.
Photos, device screen imagery and complex illustrations remain light gray; simple SVG graphics and device outer frames have been restored.

Some very small social symbols use a filled SVG silhouette; the reference gold badge treatment differs slightly. Original unknown display font widths and fine card shading also retain recorded approximations.

78 text elements across56pages use text-only glyph width approximations, scaleX1.02–1.35: p112 Montserrat titles2–3.5%, p119 Manrope titles6.5%, p127 unavailable Clash Display approximated by Inter. Stage, references, photos and SVG are not stretched. Exact original font identity is not claimed; verification lists each approximation and separately rejects stage rotation/scaling and non-text/reference aspect changes.

evidence: Per-page owner and helper comparisons contain exact measured correction notes and remaining differences; baseline artefact paths are historical provenance and do not imply current final PNG identity.
